about: The decorative grass layer's data (B18, D-game-34 item 34). tops are the block kinds the tufts stand on (a tuft stands on the top face of such a block and only where the cell above is air). weights are the share of those columns that can carry a tuft at the slider's 100 percent, by biome id (from game/biomes.json), 0 to 1: lush in plains and meadows, thick on the forest floors, thin in the taiga and the grove. other is the weight of a biome not listed; unplaced is the weight where the world has no place query (the bounded valley, whose ground is all meadow). This file is render data only: nothing here reaches the world's generation, its digest or a save.
